hypothesis_mappings.formal_claim: Equal-information ternary storage can have lower total physical cost than binary storage under stated device and overhead assumptions.
hypothesis_mappings.canonical_result: D: ideal threshold derived; M=256 and C3/C2=1.5 gives ternary cost 9 vs binary 8. B: current RTL uses two binary bits per trit and supplies no measured three-state-device advantage.
hypothesis_mappings.confidence: High for exact arithmetic/source facts; physical advantage open.
hypothesis_mappings.baseline: Optimally packed binary representation of the same M states; same reliability, access and I/O requirements.
hypothesis_mappings.unresolved_limitations: Use storage_boundary.py and selected factorial model; require independent device data before physical claims.

linked_studies.scope: Phase 0 charter and Gate 1 implementation/correction (#763/#765) merged. #765 has two unresolved evidence-pin/schema-type findings; Gate 1 acceptance and Gate 2 withheld. R1 negative findings retained. No runtime or physical advantage established.
Historical exploratory software scalar tryte addition incurred 10.6x instruction overhead compared to native 64-bit Boolean addition; closed for scalar software.

hypothesis_mappings.formal_claim: Balanced ternary can improve a specified signed arithmetic or rounding task at equal semantics and cost accounting.
hypothesis_mappings.canonical_result: A: isolated current CWEB routines fail balanced positional semantics: addition 422/547; multiplication 140/201; negation 0/27 failures. This rejects these routines as evidence, not balanced ternary mathematics. Multiplication is documented as componentwise; the oracle failure rules it out for positional-integer claims, not for a separately specified vector algebra.
hypothesis_mappings.confidence: High for isolated reproduction; complete Hanoi integration untested.
hypothesis_mappings.baseline: Exact integer oracle, competitive binary signed arithmetic and a correct ternary candidate.
hypothesis_mappings.unresolved_limitations: Preserve failures; specify domain and correct oracle before any performance comparison; do not rewrite Hanoi.

linked_studies.scope: Phases 1-6 arithmetic qualification; reproducers F1-F7 pass unconditionally against ExactBigIntOracle; executive disposition QUALIFIED WITH LIMITATIONS.

Phase 0 charter and Gate 1 implementation/correction (#763/#765) merged. #765 has two unresolved evidence-pin/schema-type findings; Gate 1 acceptance and Gate 2 withheld. R1 negative findings retained. No runtime or physical advantage established.

hypothesis_mappings.formal_claim: Grouping four trits as base-81 can provide a workload-specific interface or execution benefit beyond equivalent binary packing.
hypothesis_mappings.canonical_result: D: four-trit grouping established. B: grouped numeric/data surfaces exist; no grouping-specific performance advantage reproduced in this session.
hypothesis_mappings.baseline: Ungrouped ternary, binary bit-packed and binary limb representations with equal value domains.
hypothesis_mappings.unresolved_limitations: Keep mathematical grouping distinct from kernel speed and physical storage; isolate grouping in a later ablation.

linked_studies.scope: Grouping four trits as base-81 digit established in TISC specification and limb encodings; execution advantage unverified.

hypothesis_mappings.unresolved_limitations: Select H04-R01 capacity-trace discriminator as a declared refinement, not a reconstruction of working Hanoi semantics.
